europe_now.title: US Waives Russia Sanctions Amid Tensions With Ukraine
europe_now.summary: The United States has waived several Russia sanctions as diplomatic tensions with Ukrainian leadership intensify. European officials have criticized restrictions on support for Ukraine while seeking to strengthen regional backing.

europe_now.title: EU Leaders Debate Migration Policies and Border Regularization
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders at the Brussels summit clashed over migration policies and budget discussions without reaching final decisions. Criticism was directed at Spain's migrant regularization plans during the high-level regional negotiations.

top_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy turned to European leaders for backing amid escalating diplomatic friction with the United States. European ministers criticized US restrictions on support while discussing alternative satellite communication and security needs.
